messages.author: 029c9bb847a9e034
messages.subject: Adding geom_text to layers
parts:
Hi,

I ran into an issue where I can not add geom_text. When I attempt to
create a geom_point layer object and add it to a ggplot object with a
geom_text in the following manners, i get an error:

> ggplot() + geom_point(data=japanese_autos, mapping=aes(label=cyl, x=hwy,y=cty,label=cyl)) + geom_text(aes(label=cyl))
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'cyl' not found

-- or --

> e <-ggplot() + geom_point(data=japanese_autos, mapping=aes(label=cyl, x=hwy,y=cty,label=cyl))
> e + geom_text(aes(label=cyl))
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'cyl' not found


However if I perform the following:

ggplot(mpg, aes(label=cyl, x=hwy,y=cty)) + geom_text(aes(label=cyl))

the geom_text is applied to the data set on the plot.


How do I get the geom_text to operate on the geom_point layer, rather
than performing on the ggplot object, or am I thinking about this in
the wrong way?


Thanks in advance,

-- Adam

messages.subject: Re: Adding geom_text to layers
parts: On Aug 28, 2011, at 11:43, Adam Pridgen <adam.p...@thecoverofnight.com> wrote:

> Hi,
>
> I ran into an issue where I can not add geom_text. When I attempt to
> create a geom_point layer object and add it to a ggplot object with a
> geom_text in the following manners, i get an error:
>
>> ggplot() + geom_point(data=japanese_autos, mapping=aes(label=cyl, x=hwy,y=cty,label=cyl)) + geom_text(aes(label=cyl))
> Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'cyl' not found
>
> -- or --
>
>> e <-ggplot() + geom_point(data=japanese_autos, mapping=aes(label=cyl, x=hwy,y=cty,label=cyl))
>> e + geom_text(aes(label=cyl))
> Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'cyl' not found
>
>
> However if I perform the following:
>
> ggplot(mpg, aes(label=cyl, x=hwy,y=cty)) + geom_text(aes(label=cyl))
>
> the geom_text is applied to the data set on the plot.
>
>
> How do I get the geom_text to operate on the geom_point layer, rather
> than performing on the ggplot object, or am I thinking about this in
> the wrong way?

Thinking about the wrong way. ggplot() isn't there because Hadley wants to make sure we remember the package name (he wouldn't have given us qplot if that was the case), it sets the base mapping. You can override it for a partiular geom as you do with geom_point, but you would need to do the same for geom_text then because geom_point won't share information with geom_text like ggplot will. More generally, if many gems will be using the same mapping, put it in ggplot. If the mappings are different but the dataset is the same, put the dataset in ggplot, if the data and the mappings are different my advice would be to switch to fingerpainting (okay there are some legitimate situations where different mappings of different datasets should be graphed together but fingerpainting can be fun so I stick by my advice).

Cheers,

Josh

PS if you didn't know ou could add that stuff to ggplot, it's just like in geom_point using aes() and the data argument
